bifrost: springboard/src/shell/store/ (api.rs StoreApp catalogue, mod.rs browse/GET/OPEN/Updates, install.rs sha256-checked installs); no commerce API in springboard/sdk/src or springboard/ui/src
summary: BifrOSt has a free app catalogue and installer (browse, install, update, changelog, sha256 check), which covers only the product-page and download side of the App Store. Purchase intents from promotions are queued, and store transactions can be synced into an entitlement ledger. Purchases, signed JWS verification, subscriptions, offers, review prompts and StoreKit testing have no counterpart.

features.note: StoreApp carries the price (minor units and currency), age rating, product type (consumable, non-consumable, non-renewable, auto-renewable), screenshots, release notes and install kind; no subscription status or renewal info yet. Tests: entries_missing_a_required_field_or_with_a_bad_version_or_hash_are_skipped, a_paid_entry_carries_its_price_rating_product_type_and_screenshots, release_dates_read_as_today_yesterday_days_ago_or_a_full_date (springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10.rs). Wired into the UI in wiring wave 5 (0.5.43); verify on Midget for parity.

Pure model: price text, one purchase attempt from the confirmation sheet to a final result, store failures (network, store, unknown, restriction, unsold product) with retry for the transient ones, and the install gate that allows a paid package only after success. Tests: springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-08.rs (purchase_*), parity_sdk-complete-27.rs and the purchase unit tests. The shell wiring (press_button refuses paid apps, open_sheet, finish_purchase in springboard/src/shell/store) is not verified on Midget. Gap: no store payment sheet yet, which needs the shell and a store service.

Pure ledger of purchases: record, revoke, finish, the latest purchase per product and the current entitlements on a day, with grace-period access. Tests: springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-08.rs (ledger_*) and the entitlement unit tests. The shell keeps installed state in apps/installed.json and reads it through AppStore::purchased; that path is not covered by these tests and not verified on Midget. No app-facing transaction API yet.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 5 (w5-storekit, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. package hash is checked; there is no signed-receipt or signed-transaction verification

features.note: Period arithmetic with month and year clamping, the paid, grace, billing-retry and expired states, the next expiration, and subscription groups (tier levels, an upgrade that takes effect now, a downgrade at renewal). Tests: springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-08.rs (subscription_*), parity_sdk-complete-27.rs and the subscription unit tests. Gap: no billing backend, so the store supplies the dates and the group membership.

features.note: Apple Account and Apple-hosted asset packs

gaps: No purchase API: no product lookup with price, no purchase flow, no paid-app install path (springboard/src/shell/store/api.rs has no price or product type).
No transactions or entitlements API for apps to ask what the user has bought or is entitled to.
No signed transaction verification (JWS) beyond the package sha256 check in springboard/src/shell/store/install.rs.
No subscriptions, renewal state, offers, offer codes or win-back offers.
No review prompt API (RequestReviewAction / SKStoreReviewController equivalent) in springboard/sdk/src.
No StoreKit-style test harness for purchase flows in springboard/sdk/src/testing.rs.
Storefront, App Store messages, ad attribution, external purchase and payment method binding are Apple-service specific and have no counterpart (status n/a).
